characterList.description: A male voice speaking English with an Asian accent.
characterList.name: Narrator

content_metadata.description: A tutorial video focusing on the concept of resonance, demonstrated using a physics simulation applet on an Android device.

qAndA.question: What color represents the driving force on the graph?
What happens to the maximum amplitude as damping increases?

qAndA.answer: Slightly less than the natural frequency (shifted to the left of F/f0 = 1).
qAndA.question: At what driving frequency does maximum amplitude occur in a system with light damping?

qAndA.answer: To speed up the simulation and show the results more quickly.
qAndA.question: Why does the narrator change the 'dt' value in the simulation?

qAndA.answer: It flattens out and the maximum amplitude is greatly reduced, occurring close to a driving frequency of 0.
qAndA.question: What happens to the resonance curve with heavy damping?
